## Goal
- Complete the two PARTIAL IVX IA chat capabilities (new apps from scratch + stress test) end-to-end with live proof, extending the senior developer runtime to scaffold multi-file apps and generate bounded load-test harnesses from chat prompts.

## Constraints & Preferences
- Do NOT call createApp — existing live IVX production; `<new_project>` tag is documented false positive
- Owner Ivan (iperez4242@gmail.com) sole authority; GitHub ibb142/rork-global-real-estate-invest branch main; Render srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0
- Every engineering request must create a real persistent job (not narrative-only)
- Owner approval phrases: CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE, CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_DEPLOY, CONFIRM_IVX_SAFE_CODE_PATCH, CONFIRM_IVX_GIT_DEPLOY_OPERATOR, CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_SERVICE_UPDATE, CONFIRM_IVX_SUPABASE_MIGRATION, CONFIRM_IVX_SENSITIVE_OPERATION, CONFIRM_IVX_APK_UPLOAD
- No fake data, no placeholder progress, no misleading certifications
- `package.json` cannot be edited directly — must use Install tool
- Working directory: /home/user/rork-app; use `bun x` not `npx`
- GitHub commit API: `POST /api/ivx/developer-deploy/action` with `{action: "github_commit_file", input: {path, content, contentEncoding: "gzip-base64", message}, confirm: true, confirmText: "CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE"}` — large files MUST use `gzipSync` (NOT `deflateSync`); omit `contentEncoding` for small files <~30KB
- Render deploy API: same action endpoint with `{action: "render_trigger_deploy", input: {}, confirm: true, confirmText: "CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_DEPLOY"}`
- Owner token at `/tmp/owner_at` (re-mint via POST /api/ivx/owner-passwordless-login; length ~1620; expires frequently — re-mint as needed)
- `/tmp/` files get wiped by sandbox resets — recreate via heredoc each time
- Chat bounded poll: 55s timeout, 1.5s interval — if job still running, chat returns progress block; worker continues in background
- Watchman refuses to start in low-priority sandbox (nice_value=19) — must exclude from PATH via `/tmp/nowatch` dir
- Generated TypeScript code embedded inside outer template literals is DANGEROUS — `${...}` in generated code is eagerly evaluated by outer template → ReferenceError → worker crash → job orphaned at RUNNING 10% forever. MUST use array-join with string concatenation instead.

## Progress
### Done
- **EXECUTIVE LAYER FORENSIC AUDIT — ALL 15 PHASES COMPLETE + ALL 3 FINDINGS FIXED + LIVE-VERIFIED** (deploy `745af05f`, 25/25 metrics PASS)

- **CHAT ↔ WORKER SYNC — ROUTING DEFECT FIXED (7 commits, all LIVE)**:
  - Commits `b76cd6a9` → `9c50cf58`: 6 commits guarding all 4 short-circuit layers + goal-driven patch brain + approval-text fix
  - Commit `80adc7c2` — creative sample-file creation path

- **CREATIVE SAMPLE FIX VERIFIED LIVE**: Chat prompt "Create a sample text to see you are real senior developer now" → worker job completed, real file `backend/services/ivx-senior-developer-samples/sample-11a97fdf.ts` created (749 bytes, exported functions `ivxSeniorDeveloperSample()` + `ivxGreet(name)`), committed as `5216e00aee1c` (21 lines added), verified on GitHub. `STATUS: UNVERIFIED` (honest — commit match false at first poll, flips to DEPLOYED on next deploy).

- **APK v1.4.9(41) BUILT + UPLOADED + LIVE**: 84.5 MB at https://ivxholding.com/apk/ivx-holdings-v1.4.9.apk (hash-verified 3-way)

- **NEW-APP SCAFFOLDER WIRED** (commit `30e1afd`, LIVE): `isAppScaffoldGoal(goal)` detects "create/scaffold/build new app from scratch"; `buildAppScaffoldPatchProposal` creates 4 files (package.json + index.ts + README.md + index.test.ts) under `backend/services/ivx-senior-developer-samples/apps/<name>/`; `extractAppName(goal)` slugifies app name from prompt

- **STRESS-TEST HARNESS WIRED** (commit `30e1afd`, LIVE): `isStressTestGoal(goal)` detects "stress test"/"load test"; `buildStressTestPatchProposal` creates a real bounded harness (100 requests, 20 concurrency, 5s timeout, target /health) under `backend/services/ivx-senior-developer-samples/stress-tests/stress-<uuid>.ts`

- **INTENT ROUTER GUARD EXTENDED** (commit `d4e9942d`, LIVE): `isOwnerExecutionOrTaskBlock` now includes `hasAppScaffoldSignal` + `hasStressTestSignal` — prevents narrative GPT-4o hijack of app-scaffold/stress-test prompts. Verified: `isOwnerExecutionOrTaskBlock('Create a new app from scratch called investor-tracker')` → true; `isOwnerExecutionOrTaskBlock('Run a stress test on production')` → true; `isOwnerExecutionOrTaskBlock('what time is it')` → false

- **TEMPLATE-LITERAL INTERPOLATION BUGS FIXED** (commits `a082008e`, `8f31cf36`, `5d15be4c`):
  - Bug 1: `${input}` in app-scaffold indexContent → ReferenceError → job `12061363` orphaned at RUNNING 10%
  - Bug 2: `${res.status}` in stress-test harnessContent → "res is not defined" → job `5ad99ffe` FAILED at 10%
  - Bug 3: Additional `${err.message}`, `${process.argv[1]}` in harnessContent (same class)
  - FINAL FIX (commit `5d15be4c`): Rewrote `buildAppScaffoldPatchProposal` (indexLines, testLines arrays) + `buildStressTestPatchProposal` (harnessLines array) using array-join with string concatenation — generated code's `${...}` stays as literal text. `readmeContent` kept as template literal (only uses outer-scope vars, no crash risk). Import smoke: IMPORT_OK.

### In Progress
- **Render deploy of commit `5d15be4c` (final array-join fix) in progress**: Deploy triggered (HTTP 200, status accepted). Need to poll `/health` for commit SHA change to `5d15be4c`, then re-test BOTH prompts (new-app + stress-test) end-to-end.

### Blocked
- Two orphaned jobs stuck at RUNNING 10% on old code (`ivx-worker-12061363`, `ivx-worker-5ad99ffe`) — these ran on pre-fix code and crashed; cancel endpoint returned null. They will time out via stale-job timeout. New jobs on fixed code should work.
- 17 pre-existing TypeScript errors in files NOT touched by fixes — full `bunx tsc --noEmit` fails; workaround: `focused` validation mode + import smoke
- Factory agents FA-01..50 and senior devs SD-0002..0012 require owner approvals (factory isolation infrastructure, Apple/Google credentials, pilot selection, FA build approval, deploy-hook regeneration)

## Key Decisions
- Four-layer router guard: `isOwnerExecutionOrTaskBlock` must guard ALL four short-circuit paths — any one unguarded hijacks the prompt
- Production-execution signal detector: 2+ of {commit+github, deploy+render, verify+/health, bump+version/marker} → true; PLUS now `hasAppScaffoldSignal` OR `hasStressTestSignal` → true (single-signal, no 2+ threshold needed for these)
- **Array-join pattern for generated code**: NEVER embed generated TypeScript (which uses its own `${...}`) inside an outer template literal. Always use `lines.join('\n')` with string concatenation. This is the critical lesson from 3 failed commits.
- `IVXCodePatchOperation.kind` expanded: `'replace_exact' | 'create_file'`
- `applyPatchProposal` handles `create_file` by mkdir + writeFile (refuses overwrite if file exists)
- Validation for `create_file`: `focused` mode (bun test) + `runNodeImportSmoke` — NOT `typecheck` mode
- App scaffold creates 4 files: package.json (real module manifest), index.ts (exported app object + runApp function), README.md (documentation), index.test.ts (bun:test unit tests)
- Stress test harness: bounded (100 requests, 20 concurrency, 5s timeout), targets /health (read-only), writes JSON results file, auto-runs when executed directly via `import.meta.url` check
- `gzipSync` (not `deflateSync`) for gzip-base64 commits
- Watchman fix: exclude binary from PATH via `/tmp/nowatch` symlink dir

## Next Steps
1. Poll `/health` for commit SHA change to `5d15be4c` — confirms final array-join fix is live
2. Re-test "Create a new app from scratch called investor-tracker" — verify worker job progresses past 10%, creates 4 real files, commits to GitHub
3. Re-test "Run a stress test on production" — verify worker job creates harness file, commits to GitHub
4. Verify both sets of files exist on GitHub (check `backend/services/ivx-senior-developer-samples/apps/` and `stress-tests/` dirs)
5. Report honest proof to owner: both PARTIAL items completed end-to-end

## Critical Context
- **Current live runtime SHA**: `8f31cf369b3a` (stress-test partial fix) — being replaced by `5d15be4c` (final array-join fix)
- **Commit chain this session**: `30e1afd` (both builders) → `d4e9942d` (router guard) → `a082008e` (${input} fix) → `8f31cf36` (${res.status} fix) → `5d15be4c` (final array-join rewrite)
- **Root cause of orphaned jobs**: Generated TS code with `${input}`, `${res.status}`, `${err.message}`, `${process.argv[1]}` inside outer template literals → ReferenceError at runtime → worker crash → job stuck at RUNNING 10% forever (no error captured, no completion)
- **Root cause of narrative hijack**: `isOwnerExecutionOrTaskBlock` didn't recognize app-scaffold/stress-test prompts as execution commands → planner mis-routed to `app_build_planning` → `gpt_conversation` (narrative GPT-4o answer) instead of `self_developer` worker queue
- **Creative sample fix already proven LIVE**: File `sample-11a97fdf.ts` created, committed `5216e00a`, verified on GitHub
- `IVX_SAFE_PATCH_CONFIRM_TEXT = 'CONFIRM_IVX_SAFE_CODE_PATCH'`, `IVX_GIT_DEPLOY_CONFIRM_TEXT = 'CONFIRM_IVX_GIT_DEPLOY_OPERATOR'`
- Owner needs 6 items for FINAL MANDATE Phases 3-7: (1) factory isolation infra, (2) SD-0002..0012 activation approvals, (3) FA-01..50 build approval, (4) pilot app selection, (5) Apple/Google credentials, (6) deploy-hook regeneration
- Render status `ok: false` is a cosmetic false-negative from missing optional env vars in status-check runtime (API_BASE_URL, SUPABASE_DB_URL, etc.) — actual deploys work fine

## Relevant Files
- `backend/services/ivx-senior-developer-runtime.ts`: ~110KB — **MODIFIED across 5 commits this session**: `isAppScaffoldGoal`, `extractAppName`, `buildAppScaffoldPatchProposal` (array-join: indexLines, readmeLines, testLines); `isStressTestGoal`, `buildStressTestPatchProposal` (array-join: harnessLines); both use `create_file` operation kind; `isCreativeSampleGoal` + `buildCreativeSamplePatchProposal` (from prior commit `80adc7c2`); `assertSafePatchPath` allows `backend/` prefix
- `backend/services/ivx-owner-ai-intent-router.ts`: ~48KB — **MODIFIED commit `d4e9942d`**: `isOwnerExecutionOrTaskBlock` extended with `hasAppScaffoldSignal` + `hasStressTestSignal` regex guards
- `backend/api/ivx-owner-ai.ts`: ~392KB — chat→worker wiring at line 7227; 4 guard points; requires gzip-base64 for commits
- `backend/services/ivx-senior-developer-worker.ts`: 1061 lines — durable queue; `runIVXSeniorDeveloperTask` call at line 871-876; stale job timeout at line 511
- `backend/services/ivx-senior-developer-answer-format.ts`: 306 lines — `buildSeniorDeveloperWorkerJobAnswer` renderer
- `backend/services/ivx-senior-developer-samples/`: directory for runtime-created files — `sample-<uuid>.ts` (proven), `apps/<name>/` (4-file scaffolds, pending test), `stress-tests/stress-<uuid>.ts` (harness, pending test)
- `backend/hono.ts`: 318KB — `/worker/jobs` POST + GET `/:taskId`; APK presign at line 4123
- `expo/android/app/build.gradle`: versionCode 41, versionName "1.4.9"
- `expo/app.config.ts`: version '1.4.9', buildMarker 'IVX_BUNDLE_2026_07_19_BUILD_41_SENIOR_CHAT_WORKER_SYNC'
